==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

As Elayne heads to her apartments she finds herself getting lost, in a palace where she's lived all her life. It finally becomes apparent that things have shifted around. After getting dressed, [[Aviendha]] examines the [[Dull dagger]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'' she has been carrying which she believes protects the bearer from the Shadow's notice. Elayne takes Aviendha to her ''ter'angreal'' stash and together they begin examining the items with Aviendha saying what she believes each does. She identifies a [[Flexible black rod]] that causes pain, a [[Metal helmet]] that operates a machine, an [[ivory box]] that holds a large library of music, a [[White bowl]] that can see things far away, a tall vase that can gather water from the air, a figurine of a bird and a blue figure of a woman were for talking to people far away, as were some earrings, finger rings and bracelets. She was able to identify the use for many other items as well. Elayne's maid [[Essande]] asks about a small male figure holding books and Aviendha distractedly channels into it and it projects the words for lies and not lies or more appropriately, fiction and not fiction. Though Elayne doesn't let Aviendha see, she is distressed at the channeling since they don't know what may have happened and tells Aviendha she shouldn't have done that. When Aviendha begs forgiveness for endangering Elayne and her unborn children, saying she has ''[[Ji'e'toh|toh]]'', Elayne replies they are safe due to Min's viewing and she has no ''toh'', but she was worried about Aviendha burning herself out or worse. As they make plans to systematically study everything, [[Nadere]] and [[Dorindha (Roofmistress)|Dorindha]] enter and inform Aviendha that the [[Aiel]] are leaving [[Caemlyn]], and she will accompany them.

Nadere asks Elayne about her midwife, but she currently does not have one. She is told to get one right away so she eats the right foods for her condition. Essande has a niece that is a midwife, so [[Melfane Dawlish]] will be summoned soon to attend Elayne. Elayne gives Aviendha one of the ''[[angreal]]'' she has along with one of the ''ter'angreal'' that allows a sleeper to enter ''[[tel'aran'rhiod]].'' They say their farewells and then Aviendha is gone with the [[Wise One|Wise Ones]].
